## Website audit tool
- [Website Audit Tool](https://www.mohitparmar.co.in/audit-tool): Paid automated audit covering CRO, SEO, GEO (AI-search visibility), AEO (answer engines), and branding consistency.

## Insights
- [Growth, CRO & Creative Guides](https://www.mohitparmar.co.in/blog/): Practical articles on conversion rate optimisation, creative systems, landing pages, ecommerce growth and AI workflows.
- [Ecommerce Conversion Funnel Analysis](https://www.mohitparmar.co.in/blog/ecommerce-conversion-funnel-analysis.html): A practical framework for finding where qualified shoppers stop progressing across landing, product, cart, checkout and purchase stages before deciding what to change.
- [Shopify Product Page CRO Checklist](https://www.mohitparmar.co.in/blog/shopify-product-page-cro-checklist.html): A practical review order for Shopify PDP clarity, media, price, variants, delivery, proof, mobile UX, add-to-cart usability and measurement.
- [Ad-to-Landing-Page Message Match](https://www.mohitparmar.co.in/blog/ad-to-landing-page-message-match.html): A practical checklist for checking whether an ad and its landing page align on promise, product, offer, audience, proof and CTA.
- [CRO Before More Ad Spend](https://www.mohitparmar.co.in/blog/cro-before-more-ad-spend.html): A practical framework for auditing measurement, intent, proof, friction, mobile experience and performance before scaling paid traffic.
